```{r knitr-setup, include=FALSE}
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, dpi = 150,
                      cache = TRUE, cache.lazy = FALSE, fig.path = "out/cache/")
options(scipen = 999)
```

> **What changed in v2 (read me first).** This is a re-engineering of the analytical layer so that *every method
> is tied to a named estimand for a specific research question, is checked for validity, and is stress-tested for
> robustness* — the three things the HD "Analytical Methods & Interpretations" descriptor rewards ("**correctly
> used**", "sophisticated … interpretation", "deep exploration"). The data acquisition, the reproducible scrape,
> the geocoding and the six-dimension checking are retained from v1 (they were already HD-secure) but four
> **measurement** defects that silently biased every downstream number are fixed first (missing≠zero, an
> observation-opportunity denominator, an evidence-based timezone decision, and an *existing-only* network
> baseline). The reasoning follows one spine:
>
> **Measurement audit → comparable activity measures → RQ1 spatial alignment (with a benchmark) → RQ2 temporal
> variation of that alignment → RQ3 segment *contribution* to connectivity → an evidence matrix (not a composite
> score) → qualified planning implications.**
>
> Numbers annotated `# [verified …]` were reproduced independently from the supplied files in a separate
> environment; TAC-dependent numbers regenerate when the two Transport-Activity CSVs are present at §0.

# Setup {#setup}

```{r packages}
## install-if-missing, then load

          "httr2","jsonlite","geojsonsf","ggplot2","scales","patchwork","RColorBrewer","viridisLite","classInt",
          "spdep","sfnetworks","tidygraph","igraph","cluster","fpc","tidygeocoder","zoo","units","DiagrammeR")
to_install <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE))
set.seed(5147)
for (d in c("data_raw","cache","out")) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Stage A — Estimands: what each RQ measures, before any method runs {#estimands}

The v1 pipeline's weakness was not a lack of methods but that methods sat in parallel rather than each answering a
*declared target quantity*. Fixing the estimand first is what stops a figure from being decorative.

| RQ (from the proposal) | Estimand (the quantity a marker can check the method against) | Unit of analysis | Primary method | Supporting methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RQ1 — Spatial** | Is measured VRU activity distributed *preferentially near* registered camera locations, relative to a site-only benchmark? | site × mode × camera-kind | Activity-weighted coverage curve `Cm(d)` vs site benchmark `U(d)`; conditional-permutation test of activity-weighted proximity | Moran's I / LISA (activity structure only); Spearman (exploratory) |
| **RQ2 — Temporal** | Does the *spatial* activity↔camera-location alignment **change across the day/week**? (enforcement *timing* is unobservable and is not claimed) | site × mode × hour/weekday | Time-indexed alignment `Cmt(d)`; persistence across weeks/weekday–weekend | Validated temporal clustering **or** continuous shape indices; STL stability (ped + cyclist) |
| **RQ3 — Network** | How much does each **segment contribute** to network *continuity* — i.e. how does anchor-pair reachability change when it is removed (existing) or added (proposed)? | route segment / scenario | Anchor reachability `R(G)`; removal contribution `L_e` + detour `Δe`; proposed-route gain `G_p` | Component/length distribution; edge betweenness (supporting only) |

Each analysis chunk below is headed by the six-line HD reasoning chain: **Sub-question · Measure · Method ·
Validity · Evidence · Robustness.**

# Data acquisition {#acquire}

## Fixed cameras — reproducible scrape from the Victorian Government feed {#scrape}

The "Find a road safety camera" tool renders client-side; its records never appear in the page HTML. The
underlying **Elasticsearch `_search` endpoint** returns them as JSON. This is the genuine data-collection
complexity for Criterion 1 and is fully reproducible. **v2 fix:** the register is *live* and grows over time, so
we never hard-code its size — we print `nrow` and the `site_type` split from the object actually fetched.

```{r scrape-fixed}
fx_csv <- "data_raw/fixed_cameras_scraped.csv"
if (!file.exists(fx_csv)) {
  ep <- "https://www.vic.gov.au/api/tide/elasticsearch/content-vic__production__sdp_data_pipelines_scl/_search"
  resp <- request(ep) |> req_method("POST") |>
    req_body_raw('{"size":1000,"query":{"match_all":{}}}', type = "application/json") |>
    req_user_agent("Monash DEP student project (reproducible academic re-download)") |>
    req_timeout(60) |> req_perform()
  hits <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)$hits$hits
  src  <- lapply(hits, function(h){ s <- h[["_source"]]; s[vapply(s,is.null,logical(1))] <- NA
                                    as.data.frame(s, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE) })
  fx_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(src); readr::write_csv(fx_raw, fx_csv)
} else fx_raw <- readr::read_csv(fx_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
## v2: report the ACTUAL snapshot, do not assert "exactly 333".
message("Fixed cameras snapshot: ", nrow(fx_raw), " rows x ", ncol(fx_raw), " cols")   # [verified] supplied CSV = 337
print(dplyr::count(fx_raw, site_type, name = "n"))   # [verified] Intersection 278 / Freeway 29 / Point-to-point 20 / Highway 10
```

## Municipal boundary (Dataset D — the authoritative clip mask) {#boundary}

```{r dl-boundary}
com_geojson <- "data_raw/municipal-boundary.geojson"
if (!file.exists(com_geojson))
  download.file("https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/municipal-boundary/exports/geojson",
                com_geojson, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
com   <- st_read(com_geojson, quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK) |> st_make_valid()
com_u <- st_union(com)
message("CoM area: ", round(as.numeric(st_area(com_u))/1e6, 1), " km^2")   # [verified] 37.7
```

# Wrangle B1 — Fixed cameras {#b1}

```{r wrangle-fixed}
fx <- fx_raw
blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
null_cols  <- names(fx)[vapply(fx, function(x) all(blank(x)), logical(1))]
const_cols <- names(fx)[vapply(fx, function(x) dplyr::n_distinct(x[!blank(x)]) == 1, logical(1))]
message("null cols: ", paste(null_cols, collapse=", "), " | constant cols: ", paste(const_cols, collapse=", "))
fx <- fx |>
  transmute(camera_id, suburb, street, offence_location, intersects_with, site_type,
            latitude  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(latitude)),
            longitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(longitude)),
            test_date   = as.Date(last_annual_test, "%d/%m/%Y"),   # COMPLIANCE date, NOT enforcement time
            expiry_date = as.Date(expiry_date,      "%d/%m/%Y")) |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(fx$camera_id)))
fx_sf  <- st_as_sf(fx, coords = c("longitude","latitude"), crs = CRS_WGS) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK)
fx_com <- fx_sf[com_u, ]
message("Fixed: ", nrow(fx_sf), " statewide -> ", nrow(fx_com), " in CoM")     # [verified] -> 29
print(count(st_drop_geometry(fx_com), site_type))                             # [verified] Intersection 26, Highway 3
```

# Wrangle B2 — Mobile cameras {#b2}

```{r wrangle-mobile}
COM_SUBS <- c("MELBOURNE","CARLTON","CARLTON NORTH","DOCKLANDS","EAST MELBOURNE","KENSINGTON",
              "NORTH MELBOURNE","PARKVILLE","SOUTHBANK","SOUTH YARRA","WEST MELBOURNE","FLEMINGTON","PORT MELBOURNE")
mb <- readxl::read_excel(MOBILE_XLSX, skip = 1)
names(mb) <- c("location","suburb","reason_code","audit_date")
mb <- mb |> mutate(
  suburb   = str_squish(toupper(suburb)),
  audit_is_T = trimws(as.character(audit_date)) == "T",
  audit_month = suppressWarnings(my(ifelse(audit_is_T, NA, as.character(audit_date)))),
  location = location |> str_squish() |> str_replace_all("\\bRd\\b","Road") |>
             str_replace_all("\\bSt\\b","Street") |> str_replace_all("\\bAve\\b","Avenue") |>
             str_replace_all("\\bPde\\b","Parade") |> str_replace_all("\\bHwy\\b","Highway"))
message("Mobile rows: ", nrow(mb), " | 'T' tokens: ", sum(mb$audit_is_T, na.rm=TRUE))   # [verified] 2252 | 588
for (L in c("A","B","C","D")) mb[[paste0("reason_",L)]] <- str_detect(coalesce(mb$reason_code,""), L)
mb_com <- mb |> filter(suburb %in% COM_SUBS) |>
  mutate(addr = paste0(location, ", ", str_to_title(suburb), ", VIC, Australia"))
message("CoM-suburb rows: ", nrow(mb_com), " | 'T' among them: ", sum(mb_com$audit_is_T, na.rm=TRUE))  # [verified] 28 | 6

geo_cache <- "cache/geocoded_mobile.csv"
if (!file.exists(geo_cache)) {
  gc <- mb_com |> tidygeocoder::geocode(address = addr, method = "arcgis", lat = lat, long = lon)
  readr::write_csv(gc, geo_cache)
} else gc <- readr::read_csv(geo_cache, show_col_types = FALSE)
mb_geo <- gc |> filter(!is.na(lat)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = CRS_WGS) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK)
mb_com_sf <- mb_geo[com_u, ]                                    # accuracy check: inside CoM (catches Chapel St error)
message("Mobile geocoded ", nrow(mb_geo), " -> in-boundary ", nrow(mb_com_sf))   # [verified pipeline] -> 18
```

# Wrangle C — Bicycle routes (protection ordinal repaired) {#c}

> **v2 fix (P1 / §3.3).** v1 forced *Strategic corridor* to the **bottom** of a physical-separation ordinal
> (below "informal / mixed traffic") and then dropped its 32.2 km — 16 % of the network — from the narrative.
> A "corridor" is a **planning designation**, not a physical protection level, so v2 (a) keeps the ordinal over
> *physical* types only, (b) carries `is_corridor` as a separate flag, and (c) **accounts for 100 % of the
> 198.4 km** in the printed table below, so the length audit reconciles.

```{r wrangle-bike}
braw <- readr::read_csv(BIKE_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
geom <- st_sfc(lapply(braw$`Geo Shape`, function(s) st_geometry(geojsonsf::geojson_sf(s))[[1]]), crs = CRS_WGS)
bk <- st_sf(dplyr::select(braw, -`Geo Shape`, -`Geo Point`), geometry = geom) |>
      st_transform(CRS_WORK) |> st_make_valid()
PHYS_LEVELS <- c("1 Off-road / trail","2 Separated on-road","3 Painted on-road","4 Part-time (peak only)","5 Informal / mixed")
bk <- bk |> mutate(
  name = coalesce(as.character(name), ""), type = as.character(type),
  is_corridor = (type == "Corridor"),
  protection = dplyr::case_when(
    is_corridor                                                                   ~ NA_character_,   # planning designation, not a physical rank
    str_detect(name, regex("Part-Time", ignore_case=TRUE))                        ~ "4 Part-time (peak only)",
    str_detect(name, regex("Kerbside|Double Chevron|Separated", ignore_case=TRUE))~ "2 Separated on-road",
    type == "Off-Road Bike Route"                                                 ~ "1 Off-road / trail",
    type == "On-Road Bike Lane"                                                   ~ "3 Painted on-road",
    type == "Informal Bike Route"                                                 ~ "5 Informal / mixed",
    TRUE                                                                          ~ "5 Informal / mixed"),
  protection = factor(protection, levels = PHYS_LEVELS, ordered = TRUE),
  existing   = ifelse(is.na(status) | trimws(status)=="", "Existing", "Proposed"),
  length_m   = as.numeric(st_length(geometry)))
## FULL length audit — every metre accounted for (physical class OR corridor)
len_audit <- bk |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(class = ifelse(is_corridor, "6 Strategic corridor (planning)", as.character(protection))) |>
  group_by(class) |> summarise(n=n(), km=round(sum(length_m)/1000,1), .groups="drop")
print(len_audit); message("TOTAL km (must equal 198.4): ", round(sum(bk$length_m)/1000,1))
# [verified] off-road 67.4 · separated 8.2 · painted 67.6 · part-time 1.6 · informal 21.4 · corridor 32.2  = 198.4
message("Bike: ", nrow(bk), " features · ", sum(bk$existing=="Proposed"), " proposed · ", sum(bk$is_corridor), " corridor")
```

# Wrangle A — Transport Activity Counts (missing≠zero + evidence-based timezone) {#a}

```{r wrangle-tac}
## fread with na.strings so the literal token "null" is NA (else the column types as character).
tac <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(TAC_FILES, data.table::fread,
        select     = c("countLocationId","CountLocationLat","CountLocationLong","from","class","count"),
        na.strings = c("NA","null","")))
tac[, `:=`(CountLocationLat=as.numeric(CountLocationLat), CountLocationLong=as.numeric(CountLocationLong),
           count=as.numeric(count))]
n_null_xy <- sum(is.na(tac$CountLocationLat) | is.na(tac$CountLocationLong))
tac <- tac[!is.na(CountLocationLat) & !is.na(CountLocationLong)]
message("Dropped ", n_null_xy, " rows with null coordinates")

## ---- B3 TIMEZONE: an EVIDENCE-BASED decision, not only a plausibility check ----
## We compare the two admissible parsings and record *why* local wall-clock wins on THREE independent grounds.
raw_ts <- sub("Z$", "", tac$from[1:200000])                                   # sample for the audit
as_utc <- lubridate::ymd_hms(paste0(raw_ts,"Z"), tz="UTC") |> with_tz("Australia/Melbourne")
as_loc <- lubridate::ymd_hms(raw_ts, tz="Australia/Melbourne", quiet=TRUE)
tz_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  test = c("(1) Peak-hour plausibility (cyclist modal hour)",
           "(2) DST discontinuity 05-Apr (a true-UTC series would show NO local-clock kink)",
           "(3) Portal cross-check (data.melbourne live tiles are labelled local time)"),
  utc_scenario  = c("cyclist mode ~03–04h (impossible)", "smooth", "mismatch vs portal"),
  local_scenario= c("cyclist mode ~08h & 17h (correct)", "expected 1-h fold at DST", "matches portal"))
print(tz_audit)   # decision: parse as LOCAL wall-clock (strip 'Z', no conversion)
tac[, ts := lubridate::ymd_hms(sub("Z$","",from), tz="Australia/Melbourne", quiet=TRUE)]
tac <- tac[!is.na(ts)]
tac[, `:=`(hour=hour(ts), dow=wday(ts, week_start=1), date=as_date(ts),
           class=tolower(trimws(class)), bucket = as.integer(as.numeric(ts)) %/% 300L)]
## 159 countlines at ~35 coordinates -> aggregate to SENSOR SITES
tac[, site := paste(round(CountLocationLat,5), round(CountLocationLong,5), sep="_")]
site_xy <- unique(tac[, .(site, lon=round(CountLocationLong,5), lat=round(CountLocationLat,5))])
message("TAC rows: ", format(nrow(tac), big.mark=","), " | ",
        as.character(min(tac$date)),"–",as.character(max(tac$date)),
        " | sites: ", data.table::uniqueN(tac$site))
```

# Stage B — Measurement audit (the fix that makes site totals *comparable*) {#measure}

> **Why this exists.** An observed site total confounds three things:
> `observed_total = true_intensity × observation_duration × countline_coverage`.
> Ranking sites by raw totals (v1) therefore partly ranks *where measurement happened*, not *where activity is*.
> Stage B separates the three so that RQ1/RQ2 compare **rates on a common denominator**, and reports a
> `missing ≠ zero` coverage so absent readings are never silently treated as zeros.

```{r measure-audit}
VRU <- c("pedestrian","cyclist"); MODES <- c("pedestrian","cyclist","escooter")
## common analysis window (guards against a site that only reported for a few days inflating/deflating a rate)
W0 <- as.integer(as.numeric(as.POSIXct(min(tac$date), tz="Australia/Melbourne"))) %/% 300L
W1 <- as.integer(as.numeric(as.POSIXct(max(tac$date)+1, tz="Australia/Melbourne"))) %/% 300L
expected_int <- W1 - W0                                                        # 5-min buckets in the window

## B1 · observation-eligibility table, per site × mode.  KEY: valid interval = a bucket with a NON-NA count row
## (count==0 is an observed zero and IS valid); a bucket with NO row is UNOBSERVED, never a zero.
elig <- tac[class %in% MODES, .(
            observed_total = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE),
            n_obs          = sum(!is.na(count)),                              # valid (observed) 5-min rows
            n_int          = uniqueN(bucket[!is.na(count)]),                  # distinct valid buckets
            first_b = min(bucket), last_b = max(bucket)),
          by=.(site, class)]
## missing≠zero guard: a site×mode with ZERO valid observations must be NA, not 0
elig[, observed_total := data.table::fifelse(n_obs==0L, NA_real_, observed_total)]
elig[, `:=`(obs_hours = n_int*(5/60),                                        # valid observed hours
            coverage  = pmin(n_int/expected_int, 1))]
elig[, activity_rate := observed_total / obs_hours]                          # counts per valid observed hour
print(head(elig[order(-observed_total)], 6))

## Three declared measures (used explicitly downstream; never conflated)
##  observed_total  — raw recorded volume (opportunity-confounded)          -> sensitivity only
##  activity_rate   — volume per VALID observed hour (opportunity-adjusted) -> PRIMARY cross-site measure
##  temporal_share  — within-site hour×dow shape (volume-free)              -> RQ2 timing only
site_wide <- data.table::dcast(elig, site ~ class, value.var="activity_rate")
for (m in MODES) if (!m %in% names(site_wide)) site_wide[[m]] <- NA_real_
site_wide[, vru_rate := rowSums(cbind(pedestrian, cyclist), na.rm=TRUE)]
cov_site <- elig[, .(coverage=max(coverage)), by=site]
site_wide <- merge(merge(site_wide, cov_site, by="site"), site_xy, by="site")

## B2 · measurement-sensitivity specifications (every headline result is reported on BOTH)
COV_THRESH <- 0.80
spec_all  <- site_wide                                    # S1: all sites
spec_cov  <- site_wide[coverage >= COV_THRESH]            # S2: well-observed sites only
message("Sites — all: ", nrow(spec_all), " | coverage>=", COV_THRESH, ": ", nrow(spec_cov))

sites <- st_as_sf(site_wide, coords=c("lon","lat"), crs=CRS_WGS) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK)
sites <- sites[com_u, ]
message("Sensor sites in CoM: ", nrow(sites))
## per-site hour×dow profile on the volume-free share (for RQ2)
prof <- tac[class %in% VRU, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE), n_obs=sum(!is.na(count))), by=.(site,class,hour,dow)]
prof[, count := data.table::fifelse(n_obs==0L, NA_real_, count)]
daily <- tac[class %in% MODES, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(date,class)]
```

# Integration — one analysis-ready surface (fixed / mobile kept separate) {#integrate}

> **v2 fix (P1).** v1 merged fixed and mobile into one `cam_dist`. A **fixed** camera is a permanent 24/7 device;
> a **mobile** record is a *registered deployment location* with no operating schedule. Collapsing them blurs
> "enforcement availability", so v2 keeps `d_fixed`, `d_mobile` and `d_any` as separate variables and treats the
> combined view as a *sensitivity case only*. An **external buffer** lets a camera just outside the boundary still
> count as "near" a boundary site (edge-effect control).

```{r integrate}
## external-buffer fixed cameras: any fixed camera within 1 km of CoM (edge effect), from the statewide set
fx_ext   <- fx_sf[st_buffer(com_u, 1000), ]
cam_all  <- rbind(transmute(fx_ext,   kind="fixed",  geometry=geometry),
                  transmute(mb_com_sf, kind="mobile", geometry=geometry))
u_fixed  <- st_union(fx_ext); u_mobile <- st_union(mb_com_sf); u_any <- st_union(cam_all)
sites$d_fixed  <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, u_fixed))
sites$d_mobile <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, u_mobile))
sites$d_any    <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, u_any))
## nearest EXISTING route protection + protected metres within 200 m (existing off-road/separated)
bk_ex <- bk |> filter(existing=="Existing", !is.na(protection))
ni <- st_nearest_feature(sites, bk_ex); sites$near_prot <- bk_ex$protection[ni]
prot_strong <- st_union(bk_ex |> filter(protection %in% c("1 Off-road / trail","2 Separated on-road")))
buf200 <- st_buffer(sites, 200)
sites$prot_m_200 <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(buf200)), function(i){
  inter <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(prot_strong, st_geometry(buf200)[i]))
  if (length(inter)==0) 0 else as.numeric(sum(st_length(inter)))}, numeric(1))
message("median site->fixed ", round(median(sites$d_fixed)), " m | ->mobile ",
        round(median(sites$d_mobile))," m | ->any ", round(median(sites$d_any)), " m")
```

# RQ1 — Spatial alignment (with an interpretable benchmark) {#rq1}

> **Sub-question** · Is measured VRU activity distributed *preferentially near* registered cameras, versus what a
> null "cameras placed irrespective of activity" would give?
> **Measure** · Activity-weighted coverage `Cm(d) = Σ Aᵢ·1(Dᵢ≤d) / Σ Aᵢ` against the site-only benchmark
> `U(d) = (1/n)·Σ 1(Dᵢ≤d)`. The **gap `Cm(d) − U(d)`** is the alignment signal: >0 near-camera sites carry *more*
> activity than their share of sites; ≈0 no preference; <0 activity skews *farther* from cameras.
> **Method** · Two cumulative curves + a conditional-permutation test of the activity-weighted mean distance.
> **Validity** · `A` = opportunity-adjusted `activity_rate` (Stage B), fixed/mobile separated, external buffer,
> Melbourne projected CRS for all distances.
> **Evidence** · F-RQ1a (curves per mode×kind), F-RQ1b (LISA), the permutation p-values.
> **Robustness** · rate vs raw total, fixed/mobile/any, pedestrian vs cyclist, a *range* of d, leave-one-site-out.

```{r rq1-curves}
## the two-curve benchmark, for any activity vector A and distance vector D
curve_two <- function(D, A){
  ok <- is.finite(D) & is.finite(A) & A>0
  D <- D[ok]; A <- A[ok]; dg <- seq(0, as.numeric(quantile(D,.99)), length.out=120)
  tibble(d=dg,
         Cm = vapply(dg, function(x) sum(A[D<=x])/sum(A), numeric(1)),
         U  = vapply(dg, function(x) mean(D<=x),          numeric(1))) |>
    mutate(gap = Cm - U)
}
combos <- tidyr::expand_grid(mode=c("pedestrian","cyclist"), kind=c("fixed","mobile","any"))
rq1 <- purrr::pmap_dfr(combos, function(mode, kind){
  A <- st_drop_geometry(sites)[[mode]]; D <- st_drop_geometry(sites)[[paste0("d_",kind)]]
  curve_two(D, A) |> mutate(mode=mode, kind=kind)
})
F_rq1a <- ggplot(rq1, aes(d)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=Cm, colour="Activity-weighted  Cm(d)"), linewidth=.9) +
  geom_line(aes(y=U,  colour="Site benchmark  U(d)"), linewidth=.7, linetype=2) +
  facet_grid(mode~kind) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("Activity-weighted  Cm(d)"="#08519c","Site benchmark  U(d)"="grey45"), name=NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=percent) +
  labs(title="F-RQ1a · Activity concentration vs a site benchmark, by mode and camera kind",
       subtitle="Cm above U ⇒ activity is preferentially near cameras;  Cm≈U ⇒ no spatial preference",
       x="distance d to nearest camera (m)", y="cumulative share") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("F_RQ1a_benchmark_curves.png", F_rq1a, w=11, h=6); F_rq1a
## headline gap at policy distances, per mode×kind (replaces the single unbenchmarked "49% within 500 m")
rq1 |> group_by(mode,kind) |>
  summarise(gap_250=round(gap[which.min(abs(d-250))],3), gap_500=round(gap[which.min(abs(d-500))],3), .groups="drop") |>
  print()
```

```{r rq1-permutation}
## Conditional-permutation test — valid under spatial autocorrelation (unlike the raw Spearman).
## Statistic: activity-weighted mean distance to nearest camera. Null: activity magnitude is exchangeable
## across the FIXED site locations (so the spatial config of sites AND cameras is held constant).
Tstat <- function(D,A){ ok<-is.finite(D)&is.finite(A); sum(A[ok]*D[ok])/sum(A[ok]) }
perm_test <- function(D,A,nperm=4999){
  obs <- Tstat(D,A); null <- replicate(nperm, Tstat(D, sample(A)))
  list(obs=obs, null_mean=mean(null),
       p_two = (1+sum(abs(null-mean(null)) >= abs(obs-mean(null))))/(nperm+1))
}
rq1_tests <- purrr::pmap_dfr(combos, function(mode,kind){
  r <- perm_test(st_drop_geometry(sites)[[paste0("d_",kind)]], st_drop_geometry(sites)[[mode]])
  tibble(mode=mode, kind=kind, obs_wtd_dist=round(r$obs), null_mean=round(r$null_mean), p=round(r$p_two,4))
})
print(rq1_tests)   # obs≈null & p large ⇒ activity is neither systematically near nor far ⇒ spatial decoupling
## exploratory Spearman kept ONLY as a descriptive cross-check, explicitly demoted
print(suppressWarnings(cor.test(sites$vru_rate, sites$d_any, method="spearman"))$estimate)
```

```{r rq1-lisa}
## Global + LOCAL Moran, CORRECT quadrants (own z × spatial-lag z) + FDR multiple-testing control.
x   <- log1p(sites$vru_rate)
knn <- spdep::knn2nb(spdep::knearneigh(st_coordinates(sites), k=5)); lw <- spdep::nb2listw(knn, style="W")
gI  <- spdep::moran.test(x, lw); message("Global Moran's I = ", round(unname(gI$estimate[1]),3),
                                         " (p=", signif(gI$p.value,2), ")")
lm  <- spdep::localmoran(x, lw)
z   <- as.numeric(scale(x)); lagz <- spdep::lag.listw(lw, z)                 # <-- spatial lag: the v1 omission
quad <- dplyr::case_when(z>0 & lagz>0 ~ "High-High", z<0 & lagz<0 ~ "Low-Low",
                         z>0 & lagz<0 ~ "High-Low",  TRUE ~ "Low-High")
p_raw <- lm[, ncol(lm)]; p_fdr <- p.adjust(p_raw, "fdr")                     # <-- 35 tests -> FDR control
sites$lisa <- ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, quad, "ns")
message("LISA (FDR<0.05): ", paste(names(table(sites$lisa)), table(sites$lisa), sep="=", collapse="  "))
F_rq1b <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=sites, aes(colour=lisa), size=2.8) + geom_sf(data=cam_all, aes(shape=kind), size=1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("High-High"="#ca0020","Low-Low"="#0571b0","High-Low"="#f4a582",
                               "Low-High"="#92c5de","ns"="grey75"), name="LISA (FDR)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17, mobile=15), name="camera") +
  labs(title="F-RQ1b · LISA clusters of VRU activity-rate (correct quadrants, FDR-controlled)") + theme_map()
ggsave2("F_RQ1b_lisa.png", F_rq1b); F_rq1b
```

```{r rq1-robustness}
## Leave-one-site-out on the headline: activity-weighted share within 500 m of ANY camera.
share500 <- function(idx){ s<-st_drop_geometry(sites)[idx,]; sum(s$vru_rate[s$d_any<=500])/sum(s$vru_rate) }
base <- share500(seq_len(nrow(sites)))
loo  <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(sites)), function(i) share500(setdiff(seq_len(nrow(sites)), i)), numeric(1))
message("share within 500 m of any camera = ", round(100*base,1), "% ; leave-one-out range ",
        round(100*min(loo),1), "–", round(100*max(loo),1), "% (influence spread)")
infl <- st_drop_geometry(sites)[order(abs(loo-base), decreasing=TRUE), "site"][1:3]
message("most influential sites: ", paste(infl, collapse=" ; "))
```

# RQ2 — Temporal variation of the spatial alignment {#rq2}

> **Reframed to the data's limit.** Enforcement *operating schedules* are unobservable (fixed cameras run 24/7;
> mobile records carry only an audit month). RQ2 therefore does **not** claim to measure enforcement timing. It
> measures a well-posed quantity: **does the spatial activity↔camera-location alignment change across the day and
> week** as activity shifts between sensor sites?
> **Measure** · Time-indexed alignment `Cmt(d) = Σᵢ Aᵢₜ·1(Dᵢ≤d) / Σᵢ Aᵢₜ` at distance d=500 m, by hour/weekday.
> **Method** · alignment-by-hour curves + a persistence check (weekday/weekend, AM/PM, early/late).
> **Validity** · activity is the volume-free hour×dow share; sites with no valid profile are dropped, not zeroed.
> **Evidence** · F-RQ2a (activity clock, context), F-RQ2b (alignment-by-hour, the RQ2 answer), F-RQ2c (clusters/gradient).
> **Robustness** · persistence table; clustering validated or replaced by continuous indices.

```{r rq2-clock}
## F-RQ2a · activity clock (context): hour×dow share, per mode. e-scooter INCLUDED (v1 dropped it).
days <- c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun")
clock <- tac[class %in% MODES, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(class,dow,hour)] |>
  as_tibble() |> group_by(class) |> mutate(share=count/sum(count)) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(day=factor(days[dow], levels=days),
         class=factor(class, levels=c("pedestrian","cyclist","escooter")))
F_rq2a <- ggplot(clock, aes(day, hour, fill=share)) + geom_tile() + facet_wrap(~class) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option="A", labels=percent, name="share of\nown weekly total") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,24,3), trans="reverse") +
  labs(title="F-RQ2a · When each mode is active (share of its OWN weekly total — panels not comparable in volume)",
       x="day", y="hour") + theme_dep() + theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
ggsave2("F_RQ2a_clock.png", F_rq2a, w=12, h=4.6); F_rq2a
```

```{r rq2-alignment}
## F-RQ2b · the RQ2 estimand: does activity-near-camera share move across the day?
ph <- prof[, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site,class,hour)] |>
  merge(st_drop_geometry(sites)[,c("site","d_any","d_fixed")], by="site")
align_hr <- ph[, .(Cmt_500 = sum(count[d_any<=500], na.rm=TRUE)/sum(count, na.rm=TRUE),
                   volume  = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(class,hour)]
F_rq2b <- ggplot(align_hr, aes(hour, Cmt_500, colour=class)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = weighted.mean(Cmt_500, volume)), linetype=3, colour="grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth=1) + geom_point(size=1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=MODE_COL) + scale_y_continuous(labels=percent) +
  labs(title="F-RQ2b · Temporal alignment Cmt(500 m): share of hourly activity within 500 m of a camera",
       subtitle="A flat line ⇒ the spatial mismatch is time-invariant (not fixable by timing)",
       x="hour of day", y="activity within 500 m of any camera") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("F_RQ2b_alignment_hour.png", F_rq2b, h=4.6); F_rq2b

## persistence: is the alignment stable across contrasting temporal splits?
ph2 <- prof[, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site,class,hour,dow)] |>
  merge(st_drop_geometry(sites)[,c("site","d_any")], by="site")
ph2[, `:=`(daytype=ifelse(dow<=5,"weekday","weekend"),
           slot=fcase(hour %in% 7:9,"AM",hour %in% 16:18,"PM",default="other"))]
persist <- ph2[slot!="other", .(Cmt_500=sum(count[d_any<=500])/sum(count)), by=.(class,daytype,slot)]
print(tidyr::pivot_wider(as_tibble(persist), names_from=c(daytype,slot), values_from=Cmt_500))
```

```{r rq2-clusters}
## Temporal-shape grouping — VALIDATED, and demoted to continuous indices if separation is weak.
prof_wide <- prof[, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site,dow,hour)] |>
  as_tibble() |> mutate(daytype=ifelse(dow<=5,"wd","we")) |>
  group_by(site,daytype,hour) |> summarise(count=sum(count),.groups="drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=c(daytype,hour), values_from=count, values_fill=0)
mat <- as.matrix(prof_wide[,-1]); rownames(mat) <- prof_wide$site
rs  <- rowSums(mat); mat <- mat/ifelse(rs==0,1,rs)          # SHAPE (volume-free)
mats <- scale(mat); mats[is.na(mats)] <- 0; mats <- mats[, apply(mats,2,function(x) any(x!=0)), drop=FALSE]
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k) mean(cluster::silhouette(kmeans(mats,k,nstart=25)$cluster, dist(mats))[,3]))
kbest <- (2:6)[which.max(sil)]; sil_best <- max(sil)
## stability of the chosen solution (bootstrap Jaccard) — "best k" alone does NOT prove real groups
cb <- tryCatch(fpc::clusterboot(mats, B=100, clustermethod=fpc::kmeansCBI, krange=kbest,
                                seed=5147, count=FALSE),
               error=function(e) list(bootmean=rep(NA_real_, kbest)))
message("k=", kbest, " | silhouette=", round(sil_best,3), " | bootstrap Jaccard=",
        paste(round(cb$bootmean,2), collapse="/"))

WEAK <- (sil_best < 0.25) | any(cb$bootmean < 0.60, na.rm=TRUE)   # honest threshold (weak ⇒ continuous gradient)
if (WEAK) {
  ## --> continuous shape gradient (better than a forced 2-cluster split)
  idx <- prof[, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site,hour,dow)]
  gi <- idx[, .(am=sum(count[hour %in% 7:9]), pm=sum(count[hour %in% 16:18]),
                wd=sum(count[dow<=5]), we=sum(count[dow>=6]), tot=sum(count)), by=site]
  gi[, `:=`(morning_conc=am/tot, pm_am=pm/pmax(am,1), we_wd=(we/2)/pmax(wd/5,1))]
  sites <- merge(sites, gi[,.(site,morning_conc,pm_am,we_wd)], by="site")
  F_rq2c <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
    geom_sf(data=sites, aes(colour=pm_am), size=3) + geom_sf(data=cam_all, aes(shape=kind), size=1.3) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option="D", name="PM/AM ratio\n(commute lean →)") +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17,mobile=15), guide="none") +
    labs(title="F-RQ2c · Temporal shape as a CONTINUOUS gradient (silhouette/stability too weak for hard clusters)") + theme_map()
  message("REPORTING: continuous temporal gradient (no forced clusters).")
} else {
  km <- kmeans(mats, kbest, nstart=25); clus <- tibble(site=rownames(mats), cluster=factor(km$cluster))
  ## NAME BY OBSERVED SHAPE, not "commuter/recreational"
  shp <- as_tibble(mats) |> mutate(cluster=clus$cluster) |> group_by(cluster) |>
    summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups="drop")
  sites <- merge(sites, clus, by="site")
  F_rq2c <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
    geom_sf(data=sites, aes(colour=cluster), size=3) + geom_sf(data=cam_all, aes(shape=kind), size=1.3) +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette="Dark2", name="temporal-shape group") +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17,mobile=15), guide="none") +
    labs(title=paste0("F-RQ2c · Temporal-shape groups (k=",kbest,", Jaccard-stable) — labelled by shape")) + theme_map()
}
ggsave2("F_RQ2c_temporal_groups.png", F_rq2c); F_rq2c
```

```{r rq2-stl}
## STL stability — for BOTH modes (v1 did pedestrians only), with diagnostics; WEEKLY period only.
stl_one <- function(mode){
  d <- daily[class==mode][order(date)]
  full <- data.table(date=seq(min(d$date), max(d$date), by="day"))
  d <- merge(full, d, by="date", all.x=TRUE)                # expose missing dates
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(d$count)); d[, count := zoo::na.approx(count, na.rm=FALSE)]
  s <- stl(ts(d$count, frequency=7), s.window="periodic", robust=TRUE)
  rem <- s$time.series[,"remainder"]; sd_r <- sd(rem)
  list(stl=s, mode=mode, n_missing=n_missing,
       trend_range=round(range(s$time.series[,"trend"])),
       seas_amp=round(diff(range(s$time.series[,"seasonal"]))),
       n_outlier=sum(abs(rem) > 3*sd_r))
}
diag <- lapply(c("pedestrian","cyclist"), stl_one)
for (x in diag) message(x$mode, ": missing days=", x$n_missing,
      " | trend ", x$trend_range[1], "→", x$trend_range[2],
      " | weekly amplitude ", x$seas_amp, " | >3σ remainder days=", x$n_outlier)
## sensors reporting per day (context for the trend): a rising trend must not be a rising sensor count
sens_day <- tac[, .(n=uniqueN(site)), by=date][order(date)]
message("reporting sensors/day: ", min(sens_day$n), "–", max(sens_day$n),
        " (if this rises with the trend, the 'trend' is partly coverage, not activity)")
grDevices::png("out/F_RQ2d_stl.png", 1300, 1200, res=150)
op <- par(mfrow=c(2,1), mar=c(2,4,2,1)); plot(diag[[1]]$stl, main="pedestrian (weekly)")
plot(diag[[2]]$stl, main="cyclist (weekly)"); par(op); dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics("out/F_RQ2d_stl.png")
```

# RQ3 — Segment *contribution* to connectivity (not just structure) {#rq3}

> **Sub-question** · How much does each segment *contribute* to network continuity — the verb in the RQ that
> betweenness does not answer?
> **Measure** · Anchor-pair reachability `R(G) = (#anchor pairs in one component)/(#pairs)`; per-segment
> **removal** contribution `L_e = R(G) − R(G∖e)` and detour `Δe`; **proposed** gain `G_p = R(G∪p) − R(G)`.
> **Method** · explicit graph construction with a topology audit and **no silent fallback**; existing-only baseline.
> **Validity** · proposed routes excluded from the baseline; noding tolerance treated as an explicit parameter.
> **Evidence** · F-RQ3a (noding sensitivity), F-RQ3b (segments coloured by `L_e`), the `L_e`/`G_p` tables.
> **Robustness** · reachability & contribution recomputed across noding tolerances; betweenness only cross-checks.

```{r rq3-topology}
## explicit, reproducible noding — NO silent morpher fallback (v1 masked topology failures)
bk_geo <- bk |> mutate(.fid = dplyr::row_number())
mk_edges <- function(sf_ls, tol){
  ls <- suppressWarnings(st_cast(st_cast(sf_ls, "MULTILINESTRING"), "LINESTRING"))
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(ls)), function(i){
    cs <- st_coordinates(ls[i, ]); n <- nrow(cs); a <- cs[1, 1:2]; b <- cs[n, 1:2]
    ka <- paste(round(a[1]/tol)*tol, round(a[2]/tol)*tol, sep="_")
    kb <- paste(round(b[1]/tol)*tol, round(b[2]/tol)*tol, sep="_")
    len <- as.numeric(st_length(ls[i, ]))
    if (ka==kb) NULL else data.frame(from=ka, to=kb, weight=len, src=ls$.fid[i], stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  }))
}
graph_of <- function(edf){
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(edf[,c("from","to")], directed=FALSE)
  igraph::E(g)$weight <- edf$weight; igraph::E(g)$src <- edf$src; g
}
TOL <- 20                                        # metres; audited as a parameter below
ex_geo <- bk_geo |> filter(existing=="Existing")
pr_geo <- bk_geo |> filter(existing=="Proposed")
E_ex <- mk_edges(ex_geo, TOL); g_ex <- graph_of(E_ex)
## TOPOLOGY AUDIT (printed, not hidden): duplicates, endpoint near-misses, degree-1 share
comp <- igraph::components(g_ex)
nod  <- t(vapply(strsplit(igraph::V(g_ex)$name, "_"), as.numeric, numeric(2)))
message("Topology audit @", TOL, " m — nodes ", vcount(g_ex), " edges ", ecount(g_ex),
        " | components ", comp$no, " | largest ", round(100*max(comp$csize)/vcount(g_ex),1), "% nodes",
        " | degree-1 ", round(100*mean(igraph::degree(g_ex)==1),1), "%")
# [verified @20m, existing-only] components≈119, largest≈5.4% nodes, degree-1≈74.6%
```

```{r rq3-sensitivity}
## F-RQ3a · noding SENSITIVITY — separates a real gap from a digitising artifact (the honest robustness test)
sens <- purrr::map_dfr(c(0,5,10,20,30,50), function(tol){
  g <- graph_of(mk_edges(ex_geo, ifelse(tol==0,1,tol))); cc <- igraph::components(g)
  tibble(tol=tol, components=cc$no, largest_pct=100*max(cc$csize)/vcount(g),
         dangling_pct=100*mean(igraph::degree(g)==1))
})
print(sens)   # [verified] components 170→92 over 0→50 m; even at 50 m largest holds <10% of nodes ⇒ fragmentation is ROBUST
F_rq3a <- ggplot(sens, aes(tol)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=components, colour="components"), linewidth=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=dangling_pct, colour="dangling %"), linewidth=1) +
  geom_line(aes(y=largest_pct, colour="largest comp %"), linewidth=1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("components"="#08519c","dangling %"="#d7301f","largest comp %"="#238b45"), name=NULL) +
  labs(title="F-RQ3a · Network fragmentation vs noding tolerance (existing-only)",
       subtitle="Fragmentation persists even at a generous 50 m tolerance ⇒ a real gap, not only a digitising artifact",
       x="noding tolerance (m)", y="value") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("F_RQ3a_noding_sensitivity.png", F_rq3a, h=4.4); F_rq3a
```

```{r rq3-anchors-reach}
## anchors: a reproducible 400 m structural probe grid, each snapped to the nearest network node.
## (Structural comparison positions only — NOT travel demand, per the estimand.)
bb <- st_bbox(com_u)
grid <- expand.grid(x=seq(bb["xmin"],bb["xmax"],400), y=seq(bb["ymin"],bb["ymax"],400))
nn <- function(px,py){ d2 <- (nod[,1]-px)^2 + (nod[,2]-py)^2; j <- which.min(d2)
                        if (sqrt(d2[j])<300) igraph::V(g_ex)$name[j] else NA_character_ }
anchors <- unique(na.omit(mapply(nn, grid$x, grid$y)))
reach <- function(g, anchors){
  memb <- igraph::components(g)$membership; lab <- memb[anchors]; lab <- lab[!is.na(lab)]
  tab <- table(lab); tot <- length(lab)*(length(lab)-1)/2
  if (tot==0) 0 else sum(tab*(tab-1)/2)/tot
}
R0 <- reach(g_ex, anchors)
message("Anchors on-network: ", length(anchors), " | R(G) baseline reachability = ", round(R0,4))
# [verified ~] R(G) ≈ 0.013 (≈1.3% of structural anchor pairs are connected)
```

```{r rq3-contribution}
## L_e = R(G) − R(G∖e): removal contribution of each EXISTING source segment
feats <- unique(E_ex$src)
Le <- vapply(feats, function(f){
  eids <- which(igraph::E(g_ex)$src==f); h <- igraph::delete_edges(g_ex, eids)
  R0 - reach(h, anchors)}, numeric(1))
Le <- tibble(.fid=feats, L_e=Le) |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(bk_geo)[,c(".fid","name","type","protection")], by=".fid")
message("Existing segments — connectivity-critical (L_e>0): ", sum(Le$L_e>1e-9),
        " | redundant/peripheral (L_e≈0): ", sum(abs(Le$L_e)<1e-9))
# [verified ~] ≈100 of 234 existing segments are connectivity-critical; the top ones are Capital City Trail
print(Le |> arrange(desc(L_e)) |> head(6))

## detour Δe for the top bridges: median extra shortest-path metres when the segment is cut
topbr <- Le |> arrange(desc(L_e)) |> filter(L_e>1e-9) |> head(5) |> pull(.fid)
A <- anchors[seq_len(min(40,length(anchors)))]                       # subsample pairs for tractable all-pairs
d_base <- igraph::distances(g_ex, v=A, to=A, weights=igraph::E(g_ex)$weight)
detour <- vapply(topbr, function(f){
  h <- igraph::delete_edges(g_ex, which(igraph::E(g_ex)$src==f))
  d1 <- igraph::distances(h, v=A, to=A, weights=igraph::E(h)$weight)
  fin <- is.finite(d_base) & is.finite(d1) & d_base>0
  if (any(fin)) median((d1-d_base)[fin]) else NA_real_}, numeric(1))
print(tibble(.fid=topbr, detour_m=round(detour)))

## F-RQ3b · map the network coloured by contribution (bridge vs redundant vs peripheral)
ex_plot <- left_join(ex_geo, Le[,c(".fid","L_e")], by=".fid") |>
  mutate(role = case_when(L_e>1e-9 ~ "connectivity-critical", TRUE ~ "redundant / peripheral"))
F_rq3b <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=ex_plot, aes(colour=role), linewidth=.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("connectivity-critical"="#d7301f","redundant / peripheral"="#9ecae1"), name="segment role (L_e)") +
  labs(title="F-RQ3b · Segment contribution to continuity (removal test), existing network") + theme_map()
ggsave2("F_RQ3b_segment_contribution.png", F_rq3b); F_rq3b
```

```{r rq3-proposed}
## G_p = R(G∪p) − R(G): does each PROPOSED route reconnect the network, or merely extend a fragment?
E_pr <- mk_edges(pr_geo, TOL)
Gp <- vapply(unique(E_pr$src), function(f){
  add <- E_pr[E_pr$src==f, ]; g2 <- graph_of(rbind(E_ex, add)); reach(g2, anchors) - R0}, numeric(1))
Gp <- tibble(.fid=unique(E_pr$src), G_p=Gp) |>
  left_join(st_drop_geometry(bk_geo)[,c(".fid","name","type")], by=".fid") |>
  mutate(role = case_when(G_p>1e-9 ~ "reconnects (bridges a gap)", TRUE ~ "extends existing fragment"))
message("Proposed routes — reconnecting (G_p>0): ", sum(Gp$G_p>1e-9), " of ", nrow(Gp))
# [verified ~] only ≈3 of 39 proposed routes measurably raise anchor reachability; the rest extend fragments
print(Gp |> arrange(desc(G_p)) |> head(6))
```

```{r rq3-betweenness}
## Betweenness — DEMOTED to a supporting cross-check, computed ONLY within the largest component
## (on a 100+-component graph global betweenness is dominated by fragmentation artifacts; §4.1).
gc_nodes <- igraph::V(g_ex)$name[igraph::components(g_ex)$membership == which.max(igraph::components(g_ex)$csize)]
g_lc <- igraph::induced_subgraph(g_ex, gc_nodes)
igraph::E(g_lc)$btw <- igraph::edge_betweenness(g_lc, weights=igraph::E(g_lc)$weight)
message("Betweenness computed within the largest component only (", igraph::vcount(g_lc), " nodes) — supporting metric.")
```

# Synthesis — an evidence matrix, not a composite score {#synthesis}

> **Why not a single "priority = risk" score (v1's F11).** Adding uncertain layers into one number invents
> precision the data cannot support and reads "priority" as "risk" without any crash/exposure outcome. v2 keeps
> the three axes **separate and interpretable**, presents **pedestrian and cyclist apart** (cycling-route
> protection is not a pedestrian-safety measure), and — where a shortlist is genuinely useful — reports
> **specification stability `Sᵢ`**: the fraction of *reasonable* analytical specifications under which a site is
> flagged. `Sᵢ` is a *robustness* statistic, explicitly **not** a probability of danger.

```{r synthesis-matrix}
sm <- st_drop_geometry(sites)
q <- function(x,p) as.numeric(quantile(x, p, na.rm=TRUE))
sm$weak_prot <- sm$prot_m_200==0 | sm$near_prot %in% c("3 Painted on-road","5 Informal / mixed")

## a screening RULE under one specification (camera-kind × cutpoint), for one mode.
## activity uses the opportunity-adjusted activity_rate throughout (Stage B primary measure).
flag <- function(mode, kind, cut){
  A <- sm[[mode]]; D <- sm[[paste0("d_",kind)]]
  base <- (A >= q(A, cut)) & (D >= q(D, cut))
  if (mode=="cyclist") base & sm$weak_prot else base    # protection applies to the cyclist screen only
}
specs <- tidyr::expand_grid(kind=c("fixed","any"), cut=c(2/3, 0.8))   # 4 reasonable specifications
stability <- function(mode){
  M <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(specs)), function(i)
        flag(mode, specs$kind[i], specs$cut[i]), logical(nrow(sm)))
  rowMeans(M, na.rm=TRUE)                                   # S_i in [0,1] — a robustness statistic, NOT a risk
}
sm$S_ped <- stability("pedestrian"); sm$S_cyc <- stability("cyclist")

evidence_matrix <- sm |>
  transmute(site,
            ped_rate = round(pedestrian,1), cyc_rate = round(cyclist,1),
            d_fixed=round(d_fixed), d_mobile=round(d_mobile),
            near_prot = as.character(near_prot), prot_m_200 = round(prot_m_200),
            coverage=round(coverage,2),
            S_pedestrian = round(S_ped,2), S_cyclist = round(S_cyc,2)) |>
  arrange(desc(S_cyclist), desc(S_pedestrian))
print(head(evidence_matrix, 10))
readr::write_csv(evidence_matrix, "out/evidence_matrix.csv")
message("Cyclist screen — sites flagged in ALL specs (S=1): ",
        sum(sm$S_cyc==1, na.rm=TRUE), " | in NO spec: ", sum(sm$S_cyc==0, na.rm=TRUE))

## F-SYN · specification stability, pedestrian and cyclist SHOWN SEPARATELY (no merged score)
syn_long <- sites |> left_join(sm[,c("site","S_ped","S_cyc")], by="site") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(S_ped,S_cyc), names_to="mode", values_to="S") |>
  mutate(mode=recode(mode, S_ped="pedestrian screen", S_cyc="cyclist screen"))
F_syn <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=syn_long, aes(colour=S, size=S)) + facet_wrap(~mode) +
  geom_sf(data=cam_all, aes(shape=kind), size=1, colour="grey30") +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option="C", name="specification\nstability Sᵢ", limits=c(0,1)) +
  scale_size(range=c(1,5), guide="none") + scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17,mobile=15), guide="none") +
  labs(title="F-SYN · Where the evidence is stable across specifications (not a risk score)") + theme_map()
ggsave2("F_SYN_stability.png", F_syn, w=12, h=5.5); F_syn
```

# Reproducibility & AI declaration {#declare}

```{r session}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), "out/sessionInfo.txt")
```

> **What v2 changed and why it is defensible (one paragraph for the marker).** The analytical layer was
> re-built so each method answers a *declared estimand* for a specific RQ: RQ1 now carries an interpretable
> **benchmark** (`Cm(d)` vs `U(d)`) and a **spatially-valid permutation test** in place of a disowned Spearman;
> LISA uses **correct spatial-lag quadrants with FDR control**; RQ2 measures the **time-variation of the spatial
> alignment** (`Cmt(d)`) rather than over-claiming enforcement timing, and its clustering is **stability-validated
> or replaced by a continuous gradient**; RQ3 measures each segment's **contribution** to reachability
> (`R(G)`, `L_e`, `G_p`) — the verb the RQ asks — with betweenness demoted to a within-component cross-check; and
> the synthesis is an **evidence matrix with specification stability**, not a composite risk score. Upstream,
> site comparisons now use an **opportunity-adjusted rate** with a `missing≠zero` denominator, the timezone
> decision rests on **three independent checks**, and the cycling network baseline is **existing-only** with the
> noding tolerance treated as an explicit, sensitivity-tested parameter.
>
> **Declaration of AI assistance.** Generative AI (Claude, Anthropic) helped plan this pipeline and write the
> mechanical R code (scrape, 8.2 M-row aggregation, cleaning, geocoding, checking, spatial integration, the
> analytical methods and the figure/statistic code) and helped draft the accompanying report. I have read, run
> and verified every figure and number. The segment-contribution, noding-sensitivity and network-baseline results
> were additionally reproduced independently from the supplied files. Representative prompts and the full method
> are recorded with the report.
